sentence: My right stick drifts a little

final.Speech: Got it! I'll set an 8% dead zone on your Right Stick to hide that drift.

Actions.Reason: Setting a dead zone of 8% to ignore the measured drift and prevent aim creep.

final.Recap: The app found your Right Stick wandered up to 6.4% from the centre when resting. I've applied an 8% dead zone, which is just above that maximum wander, so small accidental movements won't register in games.

sentence: My left stick moves on its own

final.Recap: I applied a 6% dead zone to the left stick. This value is just above the 4.2% maximum wander detected, effectively stopping the drift while keeping small movements responsive.

final.Speech: I'll set a 6% dead zone on the left stick and an 8% dead zone on the right stick to stop that creeping aim!
